speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To help me understand your knee swelling better, how long has this symptom been present, and is it accompanied by pain or difficulty moving the joint?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilic Arthropathy due to undiagnosed Hemophilia A.

REQUEST TEST: Prolonged Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT) and Factor VIII activity level.
REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray of the right knee to assess for subchondral cysts, erosions, or joint space narrowing.
